name: Endive

companions.note: Mild pest deterrence; similar cool-season timing

pnw_notes: Très Fine is a fine-leafed frisée-type endive — similar to frisée but with more delicate, lacy fronds. Slightly bitter flavor mellows with cold and blanching. Sow late summer for fall harvest; overwinters well with row cover. Blanch by tying outer leaves over the heart 1–2 weeks before harvest for a pale, tender center.

frost_hardiness.notes: Row cover below 28°F. The blanched inner center is tender and more cold-sensitive than outer leaves.
